
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55136532">
第一次发帖，一点都不紧张，不废话，网址如下：<br>
<font size="4"><font color="Red">升级车机固件有风险，操作不当易变砖</font></font><br>
https://mib-helper.com/<br>
<br>
<strong><font color="Red">导&nbsp;&nbsp;读：</font></strong>大众、奥迪、宝马等车机是MIB平台的车型，可以先在自己的车机上查看并记下车机固件版本号<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 然后去各种大师网站查询升级的下一个固件版本，记住版本号，到这个网站搜索下载升级包<br>
<strong><font color="Red">第一步：</font></strong>确定<font color="Red">正确的升级版本</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 以大众车机为类，查看版本是按住MENU键，三秒即可查看。<br>
<br>
<strong><font color="Red">第二步：</font></strong>将符合你升级的标准固件版本号文件名，输入https://mib-helper.com/，点GO!<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;在弹出网页中间部分找到 Download firmware updates from here.，点here<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;弹出的页面就是你将要升级的下载链接，应该是全选，右上角下载到电脑<br>
<strong><font color="Red">第三步：</font></strong>准备一个U 盘或者SD卡 8–32GB，这里说明一下，我使用U盘车机不识别，可能是太大了。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;格式化为 FAT32（分配单元 4096）<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;用 7-Zip 解压<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;所有文件直接放 U 盘/sd卡根目录<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;出现：metainfo2.txt、Hcupds、0480T 等<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="Red">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不要建文件夹、不要改名</font><br>
<strong><font color="Red">第四步：</font></strong>带上盘或SD卡，雄赳赳气昂昂上车（25–35 分钟），启动发动机（怠速）插入扶手箱 USB/sd<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;正常应该弹出 Update → OK，不弹出长按MENU（车型不同，方法不同），点击升级，OK<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;自动重启、黑屏、闪屏 → 正常<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;完成 → 拔 U 盘 → 重启<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;验证：设置 → 系统 → 版本信息</td></tr></tbody></table>
